reason: Complete strategy: simplicial 1-skeleton and the edge bound pi/2 exclude loops with at most two and at least four edges; the 3x3 Gram determinant is positive by the planar angle-sum argument, metric flag fills the triangle, and the corner angles in (0,pi) contradict local geodesicity; then CAT(1) via the short-loop control and the compact short-circle criterion. Axiom of Choice declared. Sources Moussong Proposition 10.1/Corollary 10.2 read in the transcription, Moeller 3.2-3.3, Charney-Davis 2.3-2.10, Bowditch 3.1/3.4 fetched and stamped.
